description: This mod was made with the purpose of evading mutes on a server if you just want to talk to your friend privately.

mods.name: Secure Chat
mods.description: This mod is designed to replace the server chat with a more secure chat, also used to bypass punishments.

releases.notes:
## Commands `/sc:connect [ip]` -> Connects to a secure server (HTTPS)
`/sc:local [ip]` -> Connects to a non-secure server (HTTP)
`/sc:message [player] [message]` -> Messages a specific player (Needs to be connected)
`/sc:msg [player] [message]` -> Alias for /sc:message
`/sc:chat [player]` -> Redirects your default chat to the player, if no arguments, resets your default chat
`/sc:disconnect` -> Disconnects from the server if connected
## Hosting the server The server which is the backend for the messaging api can be hosted with a serverless host like Vercel. However you can use your own computer IP but you'll have to connect using `/sc:local`. ### API Endpoints: `/send` -> POST request - username, target and message.
Sends a message to the target as the username. `/poll` -> POST request - username
Fetches all the unseen messages from the username. `/connect` -> GET request
Literally does nothing, just an endpoint to confirm it's a valid server.
